en.name: Amnesiac
en.ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.

zh.name: 失忆者
zh.ability: 你不知道你的能力是什么。每个白天你可以找说书人猜测一次，你会得知你的猜测有多准确。（无关/有关/接近/完美）
